criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Two-line hook under 210 chars, names the readiness claim verbatim, signals the contradiction (own lease document), zero snark.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Seven outlets repeated the readiness framing; shaping capital allocation by ANC contractors and state planners on active Q2 2026 solicitations at JBER, Eielson, Clear SFS. Correction names capital structure, 8(a) logic, demand-risk bearing.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Two generous paragraphs (JADC2/ISR/logistics need, lease revenue, aging infrastructure, Arctic INDOPACOM posture). 'None of that is spin' is an explicit concession before the turn.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: RLP language quoted verbatim from a primary federal document, Army comparator from same dossier entry, both reverified. Minor deduction: both rebuttal points cite the same ClearanceJobs article.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics every 1-2 sentences: Moriarty title/outlet/date, ClearanceJobs date, verbatim RLP, JBER/Eielson/Clear SFS, Fort Hood/Bliss/Bragg/Dugway, INDOPACOM, JADC2, ISR, Q2 2026, 8(a).

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attribution to Air & Space Forces Magazine (primary), counter-evidence to ClearanceJobs quoting the operative federal RLP (primary), all in dossier. Minor deduction: counter points run through a single outlet.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, corrective, structural, business-literate. Bullet block tight, no influencer cadence, no dunking. Consistent with post_001.md.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 450 words, 2964 chars, 2-4 sentence paragraphs, single 3-item single-clause bullet block. Scans on mobile and desktop.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closing names specific parcels (JBER, Eielson), frames a real binary (defense infrastructure vs speculative commercial compute), genuinely debatable, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can name the reframe: underwrite as commercial ground lease not defense-mission asset, adjust capital structure, 8(a) strategy, advocacy posture.

hard_fails.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fails.note: 5 hashtags, all whitelist, trailing line only.

hard_fails.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fails.note: Zero em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in body.

hard_fails.name: claim_is_attributed
hard_fails.note: Robert Moriarty quoted verbatim with title, outlet, date; traceable to dossier asserters.

hard_fails.name: steelman_present
hard_fails.note: Paragraphs 2-3 contain a genuine, generous steelman before any rebuttal.

one_sentence_fix: For a higher counter-evidence score, add a second independent outlet (e.g., the SAM.gov RLP posting) to corroborate the 'no obligation to purchase' language alongside the ClearanceJobs cite.
